page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred. Catchword at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: atque ipsi simul omnes deficient. Quoniam sic dixit Dominus ad me: Sicut leo & catulus leonis rugit super praedam suam, quado in occursum illius venit multitudo pastorum, & a voce eorum non formidat, neque per strepitum eorum humiliatur, sic descendet Dominus exercituum, ut militet pro monte Zion, & pro colle eius. Sicut aves obvolant, sic proteget Dominus exercituum Ierusalem, protegens liberabit, & transiliens saluabit. Reuertimini ab ea incredulitate in quam vos demerfistis, o filii Israel. Quoniam in die illa abijcient singuli idola argenti sui, & idola auri sui, quae fecerunt vobis manus vestrae in peccatum. Et cadet Assur in gladium, non quidem alicu-ius viri, neque gladius ullius hominis devo-rabit eum: sed fuga consulet sibi a facie gladii, & adolescentes eius erunt in dissolutio-nem. Ipse vero prae formidine ad fortali-cium suum transibit, & terrebuntur principes eius a signo, dicit Dominus, cuius ignis est in Zion, & cuius caminus in Ierusa-lem.

page.notes: The text is set in a single column. Page number read as 318 and marked doubtful. Several long-s and u/v readings were normalised as the rules require. "protegèt" appears to carry an accent over the e; it is read as proteget. The hyphen after "ANNO" in the catchword is not certain and is omitted. Show-through from the facing page on the right edge was ignored.
